# SYNESIS_E063 — Error

## Description

References file `file.syn` declared in the project was not found.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The bibliographic references file `file.syn` declared in the
  project was not found. Without it, no `@bibref` reference can
  be validated.
  Check that the file exists and that the path is correct. The path
  must be relative to the folder of the project file (`.synp`).
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **MissingBibliographyFile**: `filename`, `no_matches`
